fact: Egypt's policy on responsible AI use in government, effective 1 October 2026, bars hosting national-security, government, personal and classified data in cloud environments except where legislation or national rules expressly allow it and after security and regulatory approvals.
title: مصر تحظر استضافة البيانات الحكومية والشخصية على الحوسبة السحابية إلا بضوابط وموافقات محددة
